B3L08-G01-P210.title: Practice: S 把 NP1 + V 成 NP2

items.prompt: A suggests writing a novel based on blog entries. Complete B's response about turning travel notes into a book:

segments.traditional: 我常看你的部落格，內容很充實，可以寫小說了。
謝謝！我正打算把旅遊經驗

result.traditional: 謝謝！我正打算把旅遊經驗寫成一本書。
result.simplified: 谢谢！我正打算把旅游经验写成一本书。
result.pinyin: Xièxie! Wǒ zhèng dǎsuàn bǎ lǚyóu jīngyàn xiěchéng yì běn shū.
result.english: Thanks! I'm actually planning to turn my travel experiences into a book.

repairs.note: Use 寫成 ('write into / transform into a work'), not 寫到 (which denotes physical destination or degree).
看成 means to view or mistake as, not to write and produce a book.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 寫成.

items.prompt: A confuses similar characters. Complete B's confession about mistaking 白 for 自:

segments.traditional: 「白」跟「自」這兩個字太像了，我老是弄錯。

result.traditional: 嗯。我也常把「白」看成「自」。
result.simplified: 嗯。我也常把「白」看成「自」。
result.pinyin: Èn. Wǒ yě cháng bǎ "bái" kànchéng "zì".
result.english: Yeah. I also often mistake "bai" for "zi".

repairs.note: To express visually mistaking one character for another, use 把...看成..., not 看見 ('to see').
看成 specifically denotes confusing or mistaking one object for another.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 看成.

items.prompt: Seven people gifted a birthday cake. Complete B's reply about dividing it evenly:

segments.traditional: 這是我們七個人一起送你的蛋糕。祝你生日快樂！

result.traditional: 謝謝！我把它切成七塊，剛好一人一塊。
result.simplified: 谢谢！我把它切成七块，刚好一人一块。
result.pinyin: Xièxie! Wǒ bǎ tā qiēchéng qī kuài, gānghǎo yì rén yí kuài.
result.english: Thank you! I'll cut it into seven slices, exactly one slice per person.

repairs.note: Use 成 to denote resulting divided pieces (切成), not a location 在.
The measure word for cake slices is 塊 (切成七塊).

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 切成七塊.

items.prompt: Friend's soup is too sweet because they confused sugar for salt. How do you ask them?

result.traditional: 你煮的湯好甜，是不是把糖放成鹽了？
result.simplified: 你煮的汤好甜，是不是把糖放成盐了？
result.pinyin: Nǐ zhǔ de tāng hǎo tián, shì bú shì bǎ táng fàngchéng yán le?
result.english: Your soup is so sweet, did you put in sugar instead of salt by mistake?

repairs.note: 放成 indicates mistakenly seasoning with sugar in place of salt (result complement 成).
The physical seasoning mistake was putting it in (放成), not merely looking.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 把糖放成.

items.prompt: A advises staying home due to illness. Complete B's refusal because an exam is scheduled:

segments.traditional: 你要是覺得不舒服，就請假在家休息吧。

result.traditional: 不可以，今天有考試，再不舒服也得去學校。
result.simplified: 不可以，今天有考试，再不舒服也得去学校。
result.pinyin: Bù kěyǐ, jīntiān yǒu kǎoshì, zài bù shūfu yě děi qù xuéxiào.
result.english: No way, there's an exam today; no matter how unwell I feel, I must go to school.

repairs.note: Use 再 + Adjective + 也 to express 'no matter how uncomfortable'.
Use hypothetical concessive 再, not factual intensifier 很.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 再不舒服.

items.prompt: A baked sweet cookies. Express your willingness to taste them regardless of sweetness:

segments.traditional: 這是我做的巧克力餅乾，可能有點兒甜，嘗嘗嗎？
雖然我不愛吃甜點，但這是你做的，

result.traditional: 雖然我不愛吃甜點，但這是你做的，再甜我也要嘗嘗。
result.simplified: 虽然我不爱吃甜点，但这是你做的，再甜我也要尝尝。
result.pinyin: Suīrán wǒ bú ài chī tiándiǎn, dàn zhè shì nǐ zuò de, zài tián wǒ yě yào chángchang.
result.english: Although I don't love sweets, since you made this, no matter how sweet it is I'll still taste it.

repairs.note: Use hypothetical extreme 再甜...也... ('no matter how sweet'), not complaint 太甜.
Use 也 with an individual conditional action following 再甜.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 再甜我也.

items.prompt: A asks if a 12-hour flight to see your boyfriend is exhausting. Complete your reply:

segments.traditional: 聽說妳要坐十二小時飛機見男友，不累嗎？

result.traditional: 我們很久沒見面了，再累我也要去見他。
result.simplified: 我们很久没见面了，再累我也要去见他。
result.pinyin: Wǒmen hěn jiǔ méi jiànmiàn le, zài lèi wǒ yě yào qù jiàn tā.
result.english: We haven't seen each other in so long; no matter how tired I am, I still want to go see him.

repairs.note: Concessive extreme uses 再 ('no matter how tired'), not complaint 太.
Hypothetical condition paired with 也 uses 再, not comparative 更.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 再累我也.

items.prompt: A student finds characters hard to write. Encourage them that practice brings quick progress:

segments.traditional: 寫漢字中文才進步得快，漢字

result.traditional: 寫漢字中文才進步得快，漢字再難寫也得練習。
result.simplified: 写汉字中文才进步得快，汉字再难写也得练习。
result.pinyin: Xiě hànzì Zhōngwén cái jìnbù de kuài, hànzì zài nán xiě yě děi liànxí.
result.english: Writing characters makes your Chinese improve faster; no matter how hard characters are to write, one must still practice.

repairs.note: Use 再 + Stative Verb + 也 to set up the concessive condition.
Concessive hypothetical pattern uses 再, not 更.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 再難寫也.

items.prompt: A asks if you can stomach natto in Japan. Complete B's response about being unable to get used to it:

segments.traditional: 你住在日本一段時間了，吃得慣納豆嗎？
那種獨特的味道，我到現在還是

result.traditional: 那種獨特的味道，我到現在還是吃不慣。
result.simplified: 那种独特的味道，我到现在还是吃不惯。
result.pinyin: Nà zhǒng dútè de wèidào, wǒ dào xiànzài háishì chībúguàn.
result.english: That unique taste, even now I still can't get used to eating it.

repairs.note: The context indicates an inability to adapt; use negative potential 吃不慣.
Potential complements take 不 (吃不慣), never 沒.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 吃不慣.

items.prompt: A asks not to be called 'Miss Lin' anymore. Complete B's apology about an ingrained habit:

segments.traditional: 我們已經認識快一年了，別再叫我「林小姐」了。

result.traditional: 對不起，我平時叫慣了，一時改不過來。
result.simplified: 对不起，我平时叫惯了，一时改不过来。
result.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ píngshí jiàoguàn le, yìshí gǎibùguòlái.
result.english: Sorry, I'm used to calling you that and can't change overnight.

repairs.note: 叫得慣 is potential ('can get used to'); here an established habit is affirmed with 叫慣了.
The textbook result complement pattern is V慣了 (叫慣了).

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 叫慣了.

items.prompt: Friend recommends high heels, but you find them too high. Tell your friend you can't wear them comfortably:

segments.traditional: 這雙皮鞋跟太高了，我平時

result.traditional: 這雙皮鞋跟太高了，我平時穿不慣這麼高的鞋。
result.simplified: 这双皮鞋跟太高了，我平时穿不惯这么高的鞋。
result.pinyin: Zhè shuāng píxié gēn tài gāo le, wǒ píngshí chuānbúguàn zhème gāo de xié.
result.english: The heels on these leather shoes are too high; I'm ordinarily not used to wearing shoes this high.

repairs.note: You are declining because you cannot comfortably walk in them (穿不慣).
Negative potential complement takes 不 (穿不慣), never 沒.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 穿不慣.

items.prompt: Colleague wonders why you're moving from a convenient apartment. Explain the intolerable noise:

segments.traditional: 雖然離公司很近，但是這裡環境太吵，我實在

result.traditional: 雖然離公司很近，但是這裡環境太吵，我實在住不慣。
result.simplified: 虽然离公司很近，但是这里环境太吵，我实在住不惯。
result.pinyin: Suīrán lí gōngsī hěn jìn, dànshì zhèlǐ huánjìng tài chǎo, wǒ shízài zhùbúguàn.
result.english: Although it's close to the company, the surroundings here are too noisy; I really can't get used to living here.

repairs.note: 住得慣 expresses being able to adapt; here you cannot tolerate the noise (住不慣).
Negative potential complement takes 不 (住不慣), never 沒.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 住不慣.

items.prompt: A wants to open a restaurant. Reinforce your cautious advice with intense competition:

segments.traditional: 我想做餐廳生意，你覺得怎麼樣？

result.traditional: 做生意需要不少錢，況且現在競爭激烈，最好想清楚。
result.simplified: 做生意需要不少钱，况且现在竞争激烈，最好想清楚。
result.pinyin: Zuò shēngyì xūyào bù shǎo qián, kuàngqiě xiànzài jìngzhēng jīliè, zuìhǎo xiǎng qīngchǔ.
result.english: Doing business requires quite a bit of money, and moreover competition is fierce right now; you'd better think it through carefully.

repairs.note: 況且 adds a supplementary reason that compounds the first point, rather than introducing a contrast.
Competition is an independent concurrent factor, not caused by capital requirements.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 況且現在.

items.prompt: A asks how working with a new colleague is going. Add a compounding complaint about his carelessness:

segments.traditional: 你的新同事怎麼樣？跟大家合作愉快嗎？

result.traditional: 他沒什麼耐心，況且他又做事馬虎，合作很辛苦。
result.simplified: 他没什么耐心，况且他又做事马虎，合作很辛苦。
result.pinyin: Tā méi shénme nàixīn, kuàngqiě tā yòu zuòshì mǎhǔ, hézuò hěn xīnkǔ.
result.english: He doesn't have much patience, and moreover he does things sloppily; working with him is really strenuous.

repairs.note: 況且 introduces a reinforcing additional grievance rather than a transition.
Sloppiness is a separate flaw layered on, not a result of impatience.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 況且他又.

items.prompt: Manager offered an overseas posting. Explain turning it down due to unfamiliarity and having a young child:

result.traditional: 國外環境我不熟悉，況且孩子還小，我不想去。
result.simplified: 国外环境我不熟悉，况且孩子还小，我不想去。
result.pinyin: Guówài huánjìng wǒ bù shúxī, kuàngqiě háizi hái xiǎo, wǒ bù xiǎng qù.
result.english: I'm unfamiliar with the overseas environment, and furthermore my child is still young; I don't want to go.

repairs.note: The young child reinforces the refusal rather than contrasting with unfamiliarity.
Use 況且 to layer a secondary concrete rationale onto the primary one.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 況且孩子.

items.prompt: Friend questions your branded clothing purchases. Justify with personal earnings and durability:

result.traditional: 我自己工作賺錢，況且名牌衣服能穿很久。
result.simplified: 我自己工作赚钱，况且名牌衣服能穿很久。
result.pinyin: Wǒ zìjǐ gōngzuò zhuànqián, kuàngqiě míngpái yīfú néng chuān hěn jiǔ.
result.english: I work and earn my own money, and moreover designer clothes last a very long time.

repairs.note: Durability is a supporting justification that compounds your financial self-sufficiency (況且).
Use 況且 to link and reinforce your dual justifications.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 況且名牌.

items.prompt: A broke his brother's around-the-island bike. Tell him an apology is strictly unavoidable:

segments.traditional: 糟糕，我把哥哥準備去環島的自行車弄壞了！

result.traditional: 那你非向他道歉不可。
result.simplified: 那你非向他道歉不可。
result.pinyin: Nà nǐ fēi xiàng tā dàoqiàn bùkě.
result.english: Then you absolutely must apologize to him.

repairs.note: 非 must precede the entire prepositional phrase (非向他道歉不可).
不可 concludes the construction at the end of the sentence.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 非向他.

items.prompt: A wonders whether to give a red envelope for manager's baby. Complete B's confirmation:

segments.traditional: 經理的兒子快滿月了，我得包紅包嗎？

result.traditional: 大家都包了紅包，你非包不可。
result.simplified: 大家都包了红包，你非包不可。
result.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu bāo le hóngbāo, nǐ fēi bāo bùkě.
result.english: Everyone has given red envelopes; you simply must give one too.

repairs.note: 非 must stand directly before the main verb (非包不可).
Do not add redundant negations before 非.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 非包.

items.prompt: Foreign friend visits Taipei. Recommend Taipei 101 as an unmissable destination:

result.traditional: 來台北旅行，你非去101不可。
result.simplified: 来台北旅行，你非去101不可。
result.pinyin: Lái Táiběi lǚxíng, nǐ fēi qù 101 bùkě.
result.english: When traveling to Taipei, you absolutely must visit Taipei 101.

repairs.note: Place 非 before the verb phrase (非去101不可).
不必去 ('need not go') completely inverts the enthusiastic recommendation.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 非去101.

items.prompt: Teeth bleeding profusely after a surfing hit. State that medical attention is essential:

result.traditional: 他牙齒血流個不停，非看醫生不可。
result.simplified: 他牙齿血流个不停，非看医生不可。
result.pinyin: Tā yáchǐ xuè liú ge bùtíng, fēi kàn yīshēng bùkě.
result.english: His gums are bleeding non-stop; he absolutely must see a doctor.

items.prompt: A complains about customers non-stop bargaining. Complete B's reminder of basic human nature:

segments.traditional: 客人一進門就講價講個不停，這樣怎麼做生意啊！

result.traditional: 這很正常，畢竟誰都不想吃虧。
result.simplified: 这很正常，毕竟谁都不想吃亏。
result.pinyin: Zhè hěn zhèngcháng, bìjìng shéi dōu bù xiǎng chīkuī.
result.english: This is completely normal; after all, nobody wants to lose out.

repairs.note: 究竟 is used in questions ('on earth?'), not in explanatory grounding.
只要 introduces a condition, not an overarching fundamental truth.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 畢竟誰都.

items.prompt: A asks why people still drive when transit is convenient. Complete B's explanation about car autonomy:

segments.traditional: 捷運公車都方便，為什麼還開車上下班？

result.traditional: 有些地方公車到不了，畢竟開車還是比較自由。
result.simplified: 有些地方公车到不了，毕竟开车还是比较自由。
result.pinyin: Yǒuxiē dìfāng gōngchē dào bù liǎo, bìjìng kāichē háishì bǐjiào zìyóu.

items.prompt: Colleague works every weekend. Urge them to rest because humans aren't machines:

segments.traditional: 不是機器，累壞了會生病。

result.traditional: 別再加班了，畢竟人不是機器，累壞了會生病。
result.simplified: 别再加班了，毕竟人不是机器，累坏了会生病。
result.pinyin: Bié zài jiābān le, bìjìng rén bú shì jīqì, lèi huài le huì shēngbìng.
result.english: Stop working overtime; after all, humans aren't machines, getting exhausted will make you sick.

repairs.note: 畢竟 appeals to the indisputable reality that humans have physical limits.
偏偏 implies contrary obstinacy, which does not fit an appeal to rest.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 畢竟人.

items.prompt: Friend pushes high expectations on a three-year-old toddler. Urge moderation:

result.traditional: 別對她要求太高了，畢竟她才三歲。
result.simplified: 别对她要求太高了，毕竟她才三岁。
result.pinyin: Bié duì tā yāoqiú tài gāo le, bìjìng tā cái sān suì.
result.english: Don't demand too much of her; after all, she's only three years old.

repairs.note: 畢竟 invokes the fundamental mitigating reality ('she is only three').
難怪 expresses 'no wonder', which does not ground the plea.

items.fallbackRepair: Fill slot with 畢竟她.
